blocks.x: The Achala IT Solutions build of FinOps & Sustainable Computing: concrete interfaces at core systems, measured movement on cloud unit cost, and a delivery rhythm your control owners can plan around from week one.
FinOps & Sustainable Computing exists because the hard part of this work is not the model — it is the measurement, the ownership and the audit trail. That is what this page describes.

blocks.x: Every component in FinOps & Sustainable Computing has a contract, a version and a named owner. When something drifts, the ticket goes to a person, not to a committee — that is what the reference architecture is for.
